meta.title: Multilingual Site: Add a Language
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Multilingual Site: Add a Language".

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Multilingual Site: Add a Language', 'joomlaguide-multilingual-site-add-a-language', '

In this tour you add Spanish to a multilingual site.

The site must already be multilingual, for example made with the Multilingual Sample Data on the Home Dashboard. You:

  1. install the Spanish language and publish its content language
  2. create a Spanish main menu and its module
  3. add a Spanish category and a Spanish home page
  4. add a Spanish article, associated with the English and Dutch ones

This tour follows the tutorial Multilingual Site: Add a Language of the Joomla User Guide.
